title: The Signature Vision: Hydrogen Airliner Fleets 2.0
definition: The JAH-original Signature vision of Hydrogen Airliner Fleets 2.0.
description:

Signature fleet hulls program, charter one: master LH2 tanks at laboratory scale within the decade. Charter two: scale fleet logistics manufacturing until cost collapses. Charter three: operate airport fueling systems continuously, learning in public, improving every cycle.

This is a Signature concept — original JAH speculation, fully specified and honestly labeled. The public edition of this database carries the documented research record; this edition carries the bolder integrated vision: what Hydrogen Airliner Fleets 2.0 becomes when every piece is designed to work with every other piece from day one.

description:

What must be true first: the LH2 tanks results have to replicate outside the lab, fleet logistics manufacturing must reach pilot scale, and airport fueling operations need a year of continuous runtime. Signals to watch: peer-reviewed LH2 tanks demonstrations, fleet logistics cost curves bending down, and operators — not vendors — reporting airport fueling uptime. When all three flash green, 2032 stops being a forecast and starts being a schedule. (6 years from the 2026 baseline.)

title: Hydrogen Airliner Fleets 2.0 Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Hydrogen Airliner Fleets 2.0: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Hydrogen Airliner Fleets 2.0 — next-gen hydrogen-powered airliners.

Phase 1 — Prove (LH2 tanks): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (fleet logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (airport fueling): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (contrail science): fleet hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and aviation-scale deployment begins.

Signature edition: phases overlap aggressively — integration starts on day one. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.

Each phase has exit criteria.
